title: Do You Show Dementia Signs?
seoDescription: Answer 30 quick personal memory, word, confusion, recall, and reasoning questions. This quiz is for entertainment and self-reflection only, not a diagnosis.
summary: Answer 30 quick questions about memory slips, word mix-ups, daily thinking, recall, and basic reasoning.

homepage.title: Do You Show Dementia Signs?
homepage.summary: Three rounds of personal memory and thinking questions. See how your answers stack up.

footer.aboutText: This quiz is for general knowledge, entertainment, and self-reflection only. It is not a dementia screening tool, medical advice, diagnosis, cognitive assessment, or clinical test. Dementia symptoms can have many causes, and only a qualified healthcare professional can assess real concerns. If you are worried about memory, thinking, mood, communication, or daily functioning changes in yourself or someone else, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

stageGroups.title: Memory Clues
stageGroups.encouragement: Good start. Your first memory-check score is locked in.

questions.prompt: How often do you forget something someone told you recently?
choices: Rarely, or I remember after a moment
Sometimes, especially when I am busy
Often enough that it bothers me
Very often, and it affects my day

questions.prompt: How often do familiar everyday tasks suddenly feel confusing?
choices: Only with new or complicated tasks
Often with tasks I used to do easily

questions.prompt: How often do you struggle to find a common word while talking?
choices: Rarely, or the word comes back quickly
Often enough that conversations feel harder
Very often, and I lose track of what I was saying

questions.prompt: How often do you walk into a room and forget the reason?
choices: Rarely, or it comes back quickly
Often enough to interrupt my day

questions.prompt: How often do you repeat the same question without realizing it?
choices: Often enough that others mention it
Very often in the same conversation

questions.prompt: How often do you lose track while making a familiar meal or drink?
choices: Often enough that I avoid it

questions.prompt: Quick recall: remember this pair for later: River = 42. What word should you remember?
How often do you forget appointments even when they matter to you?
How often do you lose the thread of a simple conversation?
choices: Very often, even in quiet settings

questions.prompt: How often do familiar chores feel harder to sequence than before?
choices: Sometimes with chores I know well
Often enough that I need help

stageGroups.title: Daily Thinking Checks
stageGroups.encouragement: Keep going. The final round mixes quick reasoning and recall.

questions.prompt: How often do you feel unsure about the day, place, or route in familiar situations?
choices: Only briefly, then I orient myself
Sometimes in places I know well
Often enough that I need help

questions.prompt: How often do bills, recipes, forms, or simple plans feel harder than they used to?
choices: Only when the task is new or stressful
Sometimes with tasks that used to feel easy
Often enough that I avoid them

questions.prompt: How often do you put things in odd places and struggle to retrace your steps?
choices: Sometimes, but I usually retrace my steps
Often enough that it causes problems
Very often, and I cannot work out what happened

questions.prompt: How often do you feel turned around on a familiar walk or drive?
choices: Often enough that I avoid routes

questions.prompt: How often do you make unusual money or shopping choices that surprise you later?
choices: Very often and it causes problems

questions.prompt: How often do you lose important items in places that do not make sense?
choices: Sometimes, but I find them by retracing steps
Often enough to disrupt my day
Very often and I cannot retrace it

questions.prompt: How often do you feel less interested in normal social plans?
choices: Very often, and it feels unlike me

questions.prompt: How often do you need extra help organizing simple plans?
choices: Only for new or complicated plans

questions.prompt: How often do you confuse left and right in familiar settings?
choices: Very often in places I know

questions.prompt: How often do people say your mood or personality seems different?
choices: Often enough that I notice a pattern
Very often and it affects relationships

questions.prompt: Basic reasoning: what comes next? 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
Basic visual thinking: if you turn right from facing north, which direction are you facing?
Earlier, River was paired with which number?
Which word best completes the pair: hot is to cold as up is to ___?
If today is Tuesday, what day is it in three days?
Which item does not belong: apple, banana, carrot, orange?
You walk forward, turn left, then turn left again. Which way are you facing compared with the start?
Which sentence is easiest to follow?
choices: The keys are on the table.

questions.prompt: Remember this short list: cup, moon, train. Which item was second?
If memory or thinking changes are new, frequent, or affecting daily life, what is the best real-world step?
choices: Speak with a qualified healthcare professional
Use one quiz as a diagnosis
